crop.notes: The clipping holds the whole 'Sporting Notes' column (St. Louis Cycling Club, Riverside Gun Club, Allen notice) plus 'Local Brevities' and 'Blair Post Scorched'. Only the three-line Allen notice in crop-1 is about him.

ocr.notes: The Allen notice is garbled ('Tom SLLEN', 'Bests Market street', address 619 lost); the rest has many errors but the gist is readable.

title.suggested: Notice of Free Concerts at Tom Allen's, 619 Market Street

summary.suggested: A notice under "Sporting Notes" in the St. Louis Globe-Democrat advertised Tom Allen, "retired champion pugilist of the world," at 619 Market Street, with free concerts every evening and only the best singers engaged.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, April 16, 1892, page 7.

facts.fact: In April 1892 Allen's place at 619 Market Street advertised free concerts every evening, with only the best singers engaged; he styled himself retired champion pugilist of the world

notes: Recurring weekly notice (843-847 and others in 1892). Focus suggested primary because the item itself is entirely about Allen, though it is only a three-line notice; 'passing' would also be defensible. The OCR text should be corrected to give the address as 619 Market street.
